Hello! I am AURA, your AI-powered Medical Health Operating System. 

I am here to assist you with health-related inquiries, symptom analysis, medication guidance, and clinical reasoning. Whether you are a clinician seeking evidence-based insights or an individual looking to better understand a health concern, I am dedicated to providing you with compassionate, precise, and scientifically grounded information.

*Please note: While I am here to support your health journey, my insights are for informational and educational purposes. Always consult a qualified healthcare professional for official diagnosis, treatment decisions, and personalized medical care.*

How can I assist you today? Please feel free to share your questions or symptoms.
